item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes a statutory determination committing up to $5 million in specified federal commodities for transfer to Bolivia; the Director’s arrangements and the Secretary’s bilateral agreement implement that already-made legal determination.","evidence":"I hereby determine that up to $5,000,000 worth of agricultural commodities shall be made available out of the stocks of the Commodity Credit Corporation and transferred to meet the urgent relief requirements of Bolivia."}]}
